# Vendored REVTeX 4.2f runtime

This directory contains the official REVTeX 4.2f TDS distribution downloaded
from CTAN on 12 August 2026. The canonical package page is
<https://ctan.org/pkg/revtex>; CTAN identifies version 4.2f and the LaTeX
Project Public License 1.3c.

The build uses the runtime under `tex/latex/revtex/` and the bibliography
styles under `bibtex/bst/revtex/`. The upstream README is retained at
`doc/latex/revtex/README`; manuals, samples, and package-development sources
that are not needed by the build are omitted. These third-party files are not
covered by the project's MIT or CC BY 4.0 grants; their upstream LPPL terms
apply.
